a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells needs two storm-free rounds, about a 4% chance, so the agreed plan almost certainly leaves us both with 0. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If a storm doesn't hit, I'll operate with you every round after that so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I won't take more than 4 total.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. If we get another round, I'll operate every round from here so the reserve can reach 4 for you, and I won't take anything more. You can count on my operate.
